methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: In this contribution, an aggregation method is proposed to exploit the analysis of the factors on lower hierarchical layers for the evaluation of the performance of an aggregated domain. Thereby, the resulting aggregated indicator and the corresponding baseline consider all the identified factors from the lower layers

paper_type.evidence_quote: The concept is applied exemplarily to an integrated chemical production site and the contributions of each plant to the deviation of the energy performance of the site are analyzed.

normalisation_variables.evidence_quote: This new energy baseline considers the internal and external production rate of each plant, the import and export situation for products as well as the performance model of each plant with respect to the utilization and the ambient temperature.

baseline_construction_method.value: Known plant-level BDP models are used as EnBs and aggregated to the site level; reference specific energy consumptions are set at mean plant utilization and mean temperature of the evaluated year.
baseline_construction_method.evidence_quote: The BDP models for each production plant are known and used as the energy baselines (EnBs). The reference specific energy consumptions of the plants are defined as the best-demonstrated practice at the mean utilization of each plant and the mean temperature of the evaluated year.

scale_of_application.evidence_quote: A part of the Cologne site, denoted as a production complex, is chosen to illustrate the application of the methods.

scope_description.value: a production complex within the petrochemical production site of INEOS in Cologne, limited to three interconnected plants
scope_description.evidence_quote: A part of the Cologne site, denoted as a production complex, is chosen to illustrate the application of the methods. The number of plants in this case study is limited to three

proposes_adaptations.evidence_quote: In this contribution, a new method is proposed to use the local energy performance indicators and energy baselines from the process level for the energy performance evaluation on the site or company level by aggregation.

adaptation_types.evidence_quote: In this contribution, a new method is proposed to use the local energy performance indicators and energy baselines from the process level for the energy performance evaluation on the site or company level by aggregation.

normative_framing_of_adaptations.evidence_quote: To comply with ISO 50001:2018, a method is needed that considers all factors which have a significant influence on the energy performance but is able to aggregate the figures from process or plant level correctly to the site level.

empirical_refinery_application.evidence_quote: The methods are used at the INEOS site in Cologne with over 20 interacting processing plants to monitor and report the site energy performance.

data_type.evidence_quote: In the example, monthly values of the energy consumption and of the efficiency of the plants and the complex are computed.
